observations: Photo 0: Industrial sewing machine on a table; front/side view; no clear model number visible.
Photo 1: Side view showing the machine body and table; brand mark appears on the head but model text is not readable.
Photo 2: Rear/side view with the machine mounted on a stand; wiring/drive area visible but not enough to confirm specs.
Photo 3: Close side view of the machine head; the brand logo appears to read “EmEL” (or similar), but the exact model is not readable.

identity.kind: industrial sewing machine (straight stitch type not confirmed by photo)
identity.brand: EmEL (logo visible but model not readable)
read_from: photo 1 brand logo on machine head
photo 3 brand logo on machine head

claims.evidence: Photos show an industrial sewing machine, but stitch type (straight stitch vs other) is not confirmed because no stitch selector/label or working stitch sample is shown.

risks.risk: Machine may not be straight-stitch only (could be multi-purpose/other stitch mechanism).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the machine sewing a straight seam on fabric (showing the stitch result) and a photo of the machine’s stitch/type label or model plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an industrial sewing machine with unknown stitch capability (worst case: not confirmed straight-stitch only).

risks.risk: Working condition unknown (may have mechanical/electrical faults).
risks.proof: Ask for a video of the machine running with needle moving and feeding fabric, plus a close-up of the motor/foot pedal operation (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs service).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (belt, bobbins, presser feet, needles, spool pin, etc.).
risks.proof: Ask for a full photo of everything included laid out (feet, bobbins, needles, belt/pulley, power cable, pedal).
risks.if_unproven: Price as machine only with no guaranteed accessories.

risks.risk: Model/spec unknown (speed, motor type, needle size, feed type).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the model/serial plate and the motor label (if separate).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for generic industrial machines without confirmed specs.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/serial plate (and motor label if separate).
Video: machine running + sewing a straight seam on fabric (show stitch result).
Photo/video of included accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, belt/pulley, power cable, pedal).
response.reason: The photos confirm it is an industrial sewing machine, but they do not confirm straight-stitch type, working condition, or the exact model/spec needed to price confidently. The decisive proof is a running/sewing video and readable model/serial labels.
